q30.

memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15)
memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20)
memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25)
memo comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30)

Delivery convergence: all four build a payload and call `webhook.PostAsync` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:184). The first three route through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48) with their respective activity types (`memos.memo.created` / `.updated` / `.deleted`); the comment case sets `memos.memo.comment.created` inline. `PostAsync` enqueues onto `asyncPostQueue` (webhook.go:39), which worker goroutines drain (webhook.go:45) and hand to the actual HTTP delivery function **`webhook.Post`** at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` — the single point where every memo webhook is posted to its endpoint.
